name: onboarding-api

dependencies.name: onboarding-db
dependencies.description: Stores new hires, the shared onboarding task template, and generated onboarding tasks.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates caller tokens issued by Thunder for HR Coordinator, IT Staff, and Facilities Staff sign-in.

description: Backend API for the onboarding tracker: manages new hires, the shared onboarding task template, and the onboarding tasks generated per new hire, including computing due dates and overdue status. Enforces that IT and Facilities staff only complete their own team's tasks, while HR Coordinators can view every team's tasks for a new hire. Does not send emails or external notifications — overdue status is computed on read for the web app to display.
